subject: Fjord Health activation — prompt curation & eval integration kickoff
messages:
From: Alex Gordon <alex.gordon@fjordhealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-06-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood - activation kickoff: QMon + eval harness

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the quick onboarding touch. We (Fjord Health) are ready to move from POC to activation. Primary goals: prevent regressions on clinical triage prompts, integrate Redwood eval harness into our CI, and establish a canary/rollback policy before full traffic ramp.

Attached is a scoping matrix with our current prompt families and a short CSV of example prompts. High-level asks:
- Walkthrough of prompt curation expectations (what we should include/exclude)
- Eval harness integration checklist for our repo-based CI
- Recommended canary thresholds and rollback triggers (so legal / security can sign off)

Can we kick off with a 45m call tomorrow? Also looping in Priya (product lead) — she can share the test dataset.

Thanks,
Alex
Director of Product
Fjord Health

Attachment: fjord_scoping_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
Attachment: qmon_prompt_curation_v1.csv (CSV stub)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-06-04T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood - activation kickoff: QMon + eval harness

Alex — great to see this moving forward. Thanks for the attachments, they helped clarify the prompt families. We can do 45m tomorrow at 10:30am PT. Agenda proposal below — please adjust:

1) Quick goals alignment (5m)
2) Prompt curation walkthrough + sample prompts (10m)
3) Eval harness CI integration steps & repo layout (15m)
4) Canary rollout policy, thresholds, rollback criteria (10m)
5) Next steps & owners (5m)

High-level notes to prep:
- We recommend curating prompt families into: canonical prompt, negative examples, and guardrail tests. The CSV you attached is a good start; we'll ask for 50 canonical prompts and ~10-20 failure cases per family for eval coverage.
- For the eval harness we provide a GitHub Actions template and a test-runner that emits per-prompt metrics (accuracy, hallucination flag, latency). We will send the template after the call.
- Canary thresholds we typically start with: 1.5x baseline latency increase OR >3% drop in top-n accuracy on the canonical prompt set OR >1% increase in hallucination signal. Any of these should trigger immediate investigation and an automatic traffic rollback.

Looping Marissa for CS/implementation-level runbook and Ben for procurement/contract notes. See you tomorrow.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

--
Jasmine Liu
Redwood Inference

Quick procurement & SLA notes before the call:
- For Dedicated capacity we need a signed SOW; estimated baseline throughput for Fjord's 1k daily triage calls is ~20 tokens/sec sustained per GPU. If they plan to ramp, include 20% buffer.
- Can we add a clause for canary hold time (we typically recommend 24-48 hours of canary with metrics sampled every 5 minutes)? Legal asked that rollback is automated but requires notification to Fjord ops 15 min before traffic shift back; happy to draft language.
- Pricing: if they want the eval harness support and onboarding assistance (2 dedicated SE days), we can roll into a one-time professional services line.

I'll keep this short — see you on the call.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gordon <alex.gordon@fjordhealth.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@fjordhealth.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-06-05T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood - activation kickoff: QMon + eval harness

Alex / Priya — thanks again for the call today. Summary + implementation plan (action owners and timelines):

Summary items we agreed on:
- Fjord will provide: canonical prompt list (>=50), negative/failure examples (~10 per family), and a small labelled test set for hallucination signals (CSV). Delivery target: 2029-06-11.
- Redwood will provide: eval harness GH Action template, sample runner, and a preconfigured QMon project with alerting rules. Delivery target: 2029-06-07 (templates) and 2029-06-14 (QMon project provisioned).

Implementation milestones:
1) Prompt curation (owner: Fjord / Priya) — deadline 2029-06-11
   - Provide CSV with fields: prompt_id, prompt_text, expected_answer, failure_flag
   - Include a short rationale for each prompt (1-2 sentences)

2) Eval harness integration (owner: Jasmine) — templates by 2029-06-07
   - Steps: import GH Action, add secrets (REDBOW_API_KEY placeholder), wire test-runner to the labelled dataset, run smoke tests on PRs.
   - Acceptance: CI run passes on sample PR and artifacts uploaded to QMon (artifact id in logs).

3) QMon project & alerts (owner: Marissa) — provision by 2029-06-14
   - Canary schedule: 48h hold, sample interval 5m, rolling step: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% over 48h if pass.
   - Canary pass criteria (all must hold):
       * Latency increase < 1.25x baseline (p95)
       * Top-1 accuracy drop <= 2% absolute on canonical set
       * Hallucination signal <= +0.75% absolute
   - Immediate rollback triggers (any):
       * Latency > 2x baseline (p95) OR
       * Top-1 accuracy drop > 3.5% absolute OR
       * Hallucination signal > +1.5% absolute OR
       * New safety/PII hit rate increase > 0.25% absolute
   - Notification path: automatic Slack alert to #fjord-qmon (Fjord will create a webhook) and email to fjord-ops@fjordhealth.com. On-call rotations: Redwood SRE will be paged after automatic rollback.

4) Post-canary verification (owner: Jasmine & Fjord eng) — 1 week validation window after full ramp

Operational notes:
- We will ship a small GitHub PR template that includes an eval checklist; each model change must include a passing eval run and a short changelog entry.
- For rollback we will provide: rollback runbook, a prebuilt model variant tag to fall back to, and an automated traffic-shift job (Terraform module or Redwood Console route).

Next actions (owners + dates):
- Priya: upload canonical prompts & failure cases (2029-06-11)
- Jasmine: GH Action template + sample runner (2029-06-07)
- Marissa: provision QMon project & add initial alert rules (2029-06-14)
- Ben: SOW draft including 2 SE days + canary SLA language (2029-06-10)

If this matches your expectations I'll convert into a one-page activation runbook and share a Drive folder with templates and the rollbook.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
